topics.title: Shipping
topics.answer: We ship within 1-2 business days. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days, and express delivery takes 1-2 business days.

topics.title: Returns & Refunds
topics.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the item.

topics.title: Order Cancellation
topics.answer: Orders can be cancelled any time before they are shipped. Once an order shows as shipped, it can no longer be cancelled, but it can be returned after delivery.

topics.title: Changing an Order
topics.answer: Order changes and address updates are possible while the order is still in 'pending' or 'processing' status. After that, please contact support.

topics.title: Payment Methods
topics.answer: We accept all major credit cards and digital wallets. Payment is captured when the order is placed.
